milestone: Bounded workspace discovery for native references
implementation: Accept canonical local workspaceFolders/rootUri directories at initialization, with explicit project-manifest directory fallback when folder fields are absent
Select the innermost workspace containing the query document and discover eligible regular .k files for reference collection
Preserve existing checked declaration identities, open-buffer overlays, original UTF-16 ranges, registered URIs and deduplication
Apply fixed directory exclusions, do not follow discovered symlinks, and enforce explicit directory-entry/source-file/depth limits
Rescan and read graphs per request; fail on incomplete discovery, searched graph errors or existing graph/result budgets without a partial reference array
Advertise initialization-time workspace-folder support with dynamic change notifications disabled

coverage: Unopened direct/nested importers and declaration filtering
Fresh additions, deletions and on-disk edits
Open-buffer precedence, registered localhost URIs, close-to-disk restoration and broken source failure
Workspace folder versus rootUri precedence, nested root selection, sibling-prefix isolation and outside-root query fallback
Project-directory discovery, package mappings and explicit no-discovery setting
Explicit external package dependencies without external directory crawling or same-spelling identity merging
Exact unit file budget and explicit file/entry/depth failure tests
Default 512-file protocol budget exhaustion and next-request recovery
Invalid root parameters and corrected initialization
Existing lifecycle, edits, hover, definitions, imports, annotations, enum/pattern and reference regressions
qualification.third_party_sanitization: LLVM libraries are not rebuilt with sanitizers

limitations: Fixed exclusions only; no gitignore interpretation or configurable exclusion globs
Other workspace roots, excluded/untraversed paths and external reverse importers are outside discovery scope
Explicit imports/packages can access external dependencies; discovery boundaries are not an import sandbox
Any erroneous eligible graph can prevent a search, including an unrelated source
Synchronous fresh scanning/checking, no persistent index, filesystem watching, cancellation or latency guarantee
No atomic snapshot or adversarial concurrent-filesystem-mutation qualification; root/configuration changes require restart
No automatic rename, source writes, runtime/compiler numerical semantics, GPU, website or prototype changes
No real-editor or additional operating-system qualification; unreadable-directory behavior is implemented but not independently fault-injected
